question: Umbuzo
defaultDirections: Khetha impendulo ocinga ukuba iphendula umbuzo. Xa ugqibile, cinezela {checkAnswer}. Uza kufumana ingxelo ebonisa ukuba impendulo yakho ichanekile na kwaye uqhubeke njani.
relatedContentDescription: Oku kwenza indawo esongiweyo yomxholo onxulumene nalo mbuzo kwaye ihlala iboniswa
hintDescription: Oku kuboniswa ukuba umsebenzisi uyiphosile impendulo
evidenceDescription: Oku kuboniswa ukuba umsebenzisi uyifumene ichanekile impendulo
hotspotDirections: Khetha indawo nganye kumfanekiso ephendula umbuzo. Zili-{total} ekufuneka zifunyenwe.
keyboardDirections: Ikhibhodi: hamba uye kumfanekiso, uhambise umnqamlezo ngezitshixo zeentolo (bamba Shift ukuthatha amanyathelo amakhulu), emva koko ucinezele Enter okanye Space ukukhetha loo ndawo.
missLimitDirections: Ungaphosa izihlandlo ezi-{max} ngaphambi kokuba inzame iphele.
noMissLimitDirections: Ukuphosa akunamda. Cinezela {finish} xa ugqibile ukujonga.
stageKeys: Sebenzisa izitshixo zeentolo ukuhambisa umnqamlezo, Shift ngamanyathelo amakhulu, kunye ne-Enter okanye Space ukukhetha loo ndawo.
missNothing: Akukho nto yokufumana ku-{x}% ecaleni, {y}% ezantsi.
noHotspots: Yongeza ubuncinane indawo enye ebalulekileyo ekufuneka ifunyenwe kuseto.
editHint: Imigca ibonisa apho impendulo nganye ikhoyo kumfanekiso. Tshintsha amanani kuseto ukuyihambisa okanye ukuyilinganisa.
